name: Agent Relay Self-Hosted Encrypted Agent Inbox
free_limit: MIT-licensed self-hosted encrypted inbox for AI agent artifacts, human approval of email drafts and passkey access; no software subscription, expiry or vendor-imposed self-hosting quota stated.
watch_out: Requires your own PostgreSQL, S3-compatible storage, HTTPS/WebAuthn origin and email verification delivery; infrastructure and outbound email can cost money. Self-hosted edition is distinct from arelay.app hosted plans. Upstream is young; review security and operational readiness. Default artifact/account limits may be enforced by application configuration.
